item.subject: science
item.stem:
The diagram shows Kiara holding an opaque comb between a lamp and a white screen. Light from the lamp is blocked by the comb before it reaches the screen.

Which claims are correct? One or more options may be correct.

options.A: Moving the comb closer to the screen makes the shadow on the screen smaller.
options.B: Moving the comb closer to the lamp makes the shadow on the screen larger.
options.C: The same shadow remains visible on the screen after the lamp is switched off.
options.D: Moving the comb closer to the lamp makes the shadow on the screen smaller.
